findings.got: The mock has no roles; the gold button opens the approval window for anyone. Role split needs a native owner-key check.
findings.evidence: Rescue gold "Review & approve ↗".

findings.title: Detection needs each subscription added by hand, capped at 20 watched and 100 checks a day
findings.expected: Failed renewals appear without Lena entering them.
findings.got: Caps not testable on the mock; card shows 'Watching 2 subscriptions'.
findings.evidence: Text: "Watching | Watching 2 subscriptions".

findings.title: Failed renewals are listed with state, amount at risk, time left, and 'If you do nothing' for each
findings.expected: Criterion 1.
findings.got: Each failed renewal lists state, amount, time left and 'If you do nothing'. The deal page for the same renewal contradicts it (L2A-02).
findings.evidence: Text: "Subscriber S-14 | $12.00 | Your call | 4 days left | Care plan · subscriber S-14 · If you do nothing: nothing is sent".

findings.title: Recovered money is conservative and explained: only PayPal-paid, receipted, PayPal-reported failures count
findings.expected: A figure Lena can repeat to Maya without it being challenged.
findings.got: Recovered is conservative and explained; replay never counted.
findings.evidence: Text: "Subscriber S-07 $9.00 Paid to you, receipt saved counts as recovered"; approval step 3: "Never counted: a replayed failure".

findings.title: Customer-facing wording is fixed, neutral and visible before it is sent; no plan-wide price change is possible

findings.title: Line I (the first open line) needs a developer.paypal.com sandbox account and native key dialogs; nothing in the app helps him get them

findings.evidence: Text: "registering at developer.paypal.com creates a sandbox business account with its test keys"; after click "PayPal sandbox keys saved | Saved securely on this computer". Fixture: native credentials dialog.
